anchors: station0b head-section table (cage-spec.json anchors, read at fit time; not duplicated here)
collisionField: hair-cage1/body-exact-sdf.npz (Blender BVHTree closest point + ray-parity sign, 2 mm grid; negative inside)
comment: frozen before any fit; sha recorded in spec-sha-before-fit.txt and RESULT.txt; no edits after the sha
coverageRadius: tube_r swept per guide, rasterized with body occlusion (depth-tested against hair-cage1/body-depth.npz)
fall: gravity-straight fall from the release point to end_height(az); lateral spread + shoulder-planform U shaping + posterior drift; every fall sample projected to >= 3 mm exact-SDF clearance during generation
frame: head mm: X lateral, U anterior+ rel crown, D drop below crown; world(m) = (X/1000, crown_y - U/1000, crown_z - D/1000)
growth: (a) shell ride from the shell point above the root along the departure direction on the offset crown sphere R=90mm+shell_h, to the release contour; (b) release; (c) fall; deterministic given (roots, params)
paramsNote: 21 field parameters (card allows 20-32), all smooth azimuth/elevation fields; mirrored guides share every parameter (side = sign of root X)
regularizers: curvature (fall second differences), neighbour-smoothness (adjacent-azimuth release/end drops), soft mirror symmetry (end drops)
release: release contour drop D_rel(az) = rel_c0 + rel_c1*cos(az) + rel_s1*sin(az); clamped >= root drop + 10 mm (immediate release below the contour)
roots: E/roots-provisional.npz (positions + normals on the scalp, provisional station-owned sampling above the hairline rule stated in make_roots.py); scalp1 roots drop in by file swap, no code change
shell: offset shell of the scalp: station0b head-section ellipses (anchors table from cage-spec.json: rows [drop, xmax, ufront, uback]); section point ((a+d)*sin(th), cu+(b+d)*cos(th)) with a=xmax, b=(uf-ub)/2, cu=(uf+ub)/2, d = shell_h + lift; shell_h(h,az) = sh_base + sh_elev*(h/100) + sh_cos*cos(az) + sh_sin*sin(az), clamped >= 0.5 mm. Shell-ride blends section angle root-azimuth -> departure azimuth (root azimuth pushed laterally by part_angle). v1draft used a crown sphere R=90; replaced pre-fit (no optimizer run) because the forehead (ufront 84mm at drop 50) protrudes past the sphere and shell points read inside the exact field. Section columns are median-3 filtered at shell-read time (station-owned smoothing; raw table untouched): the raw table has single-row glitches (drop-30 uback 0.1 vs -53.4/-77.5 neighbours; 85-105 uback +/-15 oscillation) that swing unsmoothed shell points up to 25 mm inside the exact field; the card requires smooth fields.
